title: Native Learning & Research Frontier
purpose: Expand the provider-independent AI into native data/training, multimodal, research/evaluation, efficient local serving and bounded compute fabric.

workstreams.name: Data, lineage and dataset foundation
workstreams.objective: Make data ingestion, lineage, quality, datasets, synthetic data, caching, content addressing, and transaction semantics executable and provenance-bound for native learning.

workstreams.name: Native training control and recovery
workstreams.objective: Materialize a provider-independent training control plane with distributed execution, checkpoint/recovery, observability, evaluation gates, post-training, curricula, RL environments, and verifier-model custody.

workstreams.name: Multimodal ingestion and retrieval
workstreams.objective: Create typed local multimodal ingestion, vision/document/audio/video surfaces and retrieval contracts without hosted-provider dependence.

workstreams.name: Research, evidence and causal science
workstreams.objective: Materialize artifact review, research teams, literature/citation evidence, reproducibility, experiment comparison, statistics, hypotheses and causal knowledge with provenance and conflict handling.

workstreams.name: Model and agent evaluation system
workstreams.objective: Build model/agent evaluation, long-horizon benchmarks, contamination controls, human evaluation and evidence-backed model/dataset/tool/agent cards.

workstreams.name: Local model serving efficiency
workstreams.objective: Add local memory-aware serving controls, model eviction, KV/prefix caching, and speculative inference with deterministic identity and bounded fallback.

workstreams.name: Build, evaluation and research compute fabric
workstreams.objective: Create bounded build/evaluation/research compute queues with ownership, admission, cancellation, fairness, and durable evidence.

invariants: Source scope equals the exact 197-volume queue left by P3-T1.
Selected and queued partitions are disjoint and cover the source exactly.
Every scheduled volume has one task owner.
Canonical contracts, risks, gaps, tests, evaluations and accountability are inherited without narrowing.
No task can self-sign or self-promote maturity.
Local AI training and serving acceptance may not depend on hosted-provider credentials.
